warm-paper.$description: Warm Paper — Page background — the only surface; everything floats on this warm off-white

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, nav labels, footer copy — medium-dark gray keeps long-form reading comfortable without high-contrast harshness

ink.$description: Ink — Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings.

apple-system.$description: Body and navigation. At 21px / 600 / line-height 1.55 with -0.01em tracking, the system stack carries the entire page — the signature is the size and rhythm, not a custom face. 13px / 400 nav labels use the same -0.002em micro-tracking. A 16px / 400 utility size appears for small captions.

wealthsimple-sans-display.$description: Reserved for the "Wealthsimple" link — a single display-grade cut at 21px / 700 / -0.01em. It signals partnership without changing the page's monochrome restraint.
